summary: ReTo Eco-Solutions (Buyer) files Form 6-K reporting the closing of its acquisition of 51% of Seven Arrows Supply Chain Limited from Rei Shiba (Seller) through a share exchange. The consideration was newly issued ReTo Class A shares (no par value), with 25,500 ordinary shares of Seven Arrows acquired. The transaction closed on February 27, 2026. Alongside, ReTo provides audited financials of Seven Arrows and unaudited pro forma combined financials as Exhibits. No board recommendation or advisor is named. This is a completed stock-for-stock acquisition; no premium, price per share, or regulatory clock is specified. Watch for integration updates and future filings on combined operations.
